confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on aggregated, partly crowdsourced 2026 snapshots (Numbeo-derived averages, Expatistan, cafe and bar menus, and 2025 event price lists). Cocktail and wine anchors rest on thin samples and were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.1x beer, wine glass about 1.7x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates of Denver July peak-season rates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings, so they are lower confidence. The FX value of 0.6720 for 2026-11-18 comes from search results summarising the RBA RSS feed and exchange rates overview page; I did not open the F11.1 table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors are Denver-specific. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for a US mid-sized metro in peak summer, not benchmarked against a named comparable city.
